lede: The biggest thing this week is the San Miguel County BOCC, which holds public hearings on three Land Use Code amendments August 5 — changes to 'Qualified Owner' definitions, wildfire area rules, and nonconforming lots, all moving toward formal votes. Also on the 5th, the Telluride Housing Authority Subcommittee takes up whether a deed-restricted homeowner can get relief from the PCI cap to replace a roof, and Mountain Village's Design Review Board weighs in on three multifamily projects the following day.

notable.stake: Public hearings and formal votes on three county Land Use Code changes.
Vote on whether a deed-restricted owner can exceed PCI cap for a $47K roof.
Design board reviews and a conditional-use permit decision on multifamily projects.
Land use definition changes that could quietly shift what development rules allow.
